name_en: Korogaki namasu — vinegared daikon and carrot with Ujitawara's rolled dried persimmon
summary_ja: 宇治田原町特産の干し柿「古老柿」を細かく割いて、塩もみした大根と人参を酢で和える正月料理。棚に並べて干す独特の製法から名がついたとされ、素朴な甘みが縁起物として神棚にも供えられるという。
summary_en: Korogaki, a specialty dried persimmon from Ujitawara made by racking rather than hanging, is torn into pieces and tossed with vinegared daikon and carrot for New Year's. Its name is said to come from that unusual drying method, and its gentle sweetness sees it offered on household shrines too.
source_title: 古老柿なます 京都府 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
